name: PTR character copy: a character with a pet copies after a pet was summoned on this realm
contract: ObjectMgr::GeneratePetNumber pre-increments, so _hiPetNumber is the last pet number in use. PlayerDumpReader numbered the copy's pets from _hiPetNumber, so once any pet had been summoned since startup the copy's first pet reused that number and .ptr copy failed on a duplicate character_pet key (live PTR: Duplicate entry for key 'character_pet.PRIMARY'). The copy numbers its pets after the last one in use. ptr_character_copy makes this realm both the source and the target of the queued copy.

steps.label: Summon the Imp, which takes the newest pet number
SETUP: the Imp is saved as the character's pet
The source account starts with one character
Queue the copy of the character with its pet
DISCRIMINATING: the copy with its pet loads as a second character
The player is told the copy is ready
The source character keeps its own pet
